title: Polarization preserves coordinate monotonicity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and let $i,j$ be coordinates. If $f$ is monotone in coordinate $j$, then its polarization in coordinate $i$ is also monotone in coordinate $j$.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
The function is monotone in coordinate $j$
